messages:
rebecca: Observed a sustained backlog in the eu1-embed-indexer queue starting ~02:03 UTC. Background batch writes to vectorstore are delayed and some search queries return stale results.

ops-bot: Incident created: INCIDENT-2026-0708-11 — embed-indexer stall in eu1. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INCIDENT-2026-0708-11 :rotating_light:

noah: Oncall picking this up. Initial logs show indexer worker processes stuck in GC/poll waiting and high disk iowait on shard s-12. Might be compaction contention.

infra: Looks like the nightly compaction job overlapped with heavy ingest. Compaction set to aggressive level on s-12 and s-13; that combined with a large tenant backfill caused IO saturation.

rebecca: Impact: search freshness delayed for ~18 tenants in eu1; 3 tenants see >5min embedding write latency; batch jobs (offline re-rank) are timing out. No data loss — writes are queued.

support: Notifying affected tenants now; preparing public-facing line: "We're investigating delayed embedding writes and search lag in eu-west-1. Mitigation in progress. No data loss; some search results may be stale."

noah: Mitigation plan: 1) pause compaction for s-12/13, 2) scale up indexer replicas for affected shards, 3) throttle large backfill jobs. Starting actions in that order.

ops-bot: Paused compaction on s-12 and s-13 @3120001250.

infra: Scaling indexer pool: adding 4 extra replicas targeted to eu1-embed-indexer. Rolling add triggered.

rebecca: After compaction pause, queue depth down ~40% on s-12. IO wait trending down. Beginning controlled restart of 2 indexer workers to clear stalled threads.

noah: Throttling applied to tenant backfills >10k docs/hr. Config snippet: 
```
backfill_rate_limit: 10000/doc_per_hour
```
Applied at scheduler layer.

support: Posting status update with ETA: 30-50 minutes for full catch-up depending on remaining queue.

incident-bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INCIDENT-2026-0708-11 — Mitigations: compaction pause, indexer scale-up, backfill throttles.

infra: Restart wave 1 (2 workers) completed @3120001420. Those workers cleared old stuck threads; write throughput improved ~55% on s-12.

rebecca: Current state: queue draining, search freshness improving. Keeping throttles and extra replicas for 1 hour to ensure stability. Postmortem checklist: tag 'embed-indexer', capture compaction job timing, tenant backfill logs, and plan safer compaction windows.

support: Notified VIPs and updated tickets. Will send a follow-up when queues are fully drained.

noah: Thanks all — Ill own follow-up and schedule an RCA for tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
